description: This file implements a vector of instance number based selectors used for permissions management, including initialization, destruction, adding, removing, and permission matching logic.

methods.name: INST_SEL_VECTOR_Init
methods.description: Initializes an instance selector vector structure by setting its vector to NULL and entry count to zero.

methods.name: INST_SEL_VECTOR_Destroy
methods.description: Deinitializes the vector, optionally freeing individual entries and the vector itself.

methods.name: INST_SEL_VECTOR_Unwatch
methods.description: Unwatches all selectors currently being watched in the vector.

methods.name: INST_SEL_VECTOR_Fill
methods.description: Fills the vector with a specified number of entries, each initialized with a permission bitmask and wildcards.

methods.name: INST_SEL_VECTOR_Add
methods.description: Adds a new selector to the vector.

methods.name: INST_SEL_VECTOR_Remove
methods.description: Removes a selector at a specified index from the vector, optionally freeing its memory.

methods.name: INST_SEL_VECTOR_Find
methods.description: Finds the index of a specific selector in the vector.

methods.name: INST_SEL_VECTOR_GetPermissionForInstance
methods.description: Calculates the permission bitmask for a given set of instance numbers based on the vector.

methods.name: DoPermissionInstancesMatch
methods.description: Determines if a permission selector matches a given set of instance numbers, considering wildcards and flags.
